statement.p: Show that A=\left[\begin{array}{ccc} 3 \amp 0 \amp 0\cr -1 \amp 2 \amp -1\cr 0 \amp 0 \amp 3 \end{array}\right] and B=\left[\begin{array}{ccc} 6 \amp 1 \amp -1\cr 21 \amp 10 \amp -7\cr 33 \amp 11 \amp -8 \end{array}\right] are similar matrices by finding an invertible matrix P satisfying A=P^{-1} B P.
